asks: Mr. Hunter (MLA, Taber-Warner) asks the commission to divide Lethbridge into four quadrants, each joined to surrounding rural areas (a quad hybrid), and objects to Coaldale being placed with Livingstone-Macleod.

quote: I’m very much in favour of a quad hybrid boundary configuration for Lethbridge and surrounding area
note: Also: 'if you broke Lethbridge up into four ridings, you've got 25,000 in a very, very small area, and then you would need to have another 25,000 outside of that' and 'Lethbridge being broken up into, again, like, four regions and then having a rural component to it' (EB-816). Argues against keeping Lethbridge-East/West status quo ('I don't see that it isn't broken'), but rejects left blank under rule 17. Answered 'Yes' to Dr. Martin's description of commuter integration. Coaldale/Livingstone-Macleod objection is outside the eleven elements.
